text: dsh-super-chat 是面向 DSH Web 的聊天面板插件，在侧边栏提供 Super Chat 入口，并以 SQLite 保存带主题标签的单一消息流。用户可以按主题或未标记消息筛选、创建主题、编辑消息标签，并让已配置的默认模型为未标记消息补充现有主题。消息可交给 dsh-superagent-prototype 作为任务请求并在同一聊天流接收回复；未安装该服务时则由普通 DSH Session 处理。插件还提供可选的微信文件传输助手桥接。需要 DSH Web 配置的模型；微信桥接需登录凭据。

dsh-super-chat adds a topic-tagged SQLite chat panel to DSH Web. Users can filter messages, edit tags, and let the configured model tag uncategorized messages. Requests go to Superagent when available, otherwise to a DSH Session. An optional WeChat bridge is also included.
想在 DSH 网页里用一个能按主题整理消息的聊天面板
能不能把聊天内容存下来，并按标签查看不同话题
让 DSH 聊天里的消息可以手动加标签或改标签
我想让默认模型帮我给尚未分类的聊天消息补上已有主题
有没有办法把聊天请求交给 Superagent，再在原来的消息流里看回复
I want a DSH web chat that keeps messages in one stream and lets me browse by topic tags.
dsh-super-chat 的功能「主题聊天流」：在 DSH Web 侧边栏打开聊天面板，消息保存在 SQLite 的单一流中。用户可创建主题、按主题或未标记状态筛选，并为单条消息添加或修改标签。
dsh-super-chat 的功能「Superagent 对话传递」：原型服务可用时，消息作为带主题提示的请求交给 Superagent，回复回到同一聊天流；否则由普通 DSH Session 接管。
dsh-super-chat 的功能「微信桥接」：从面板打开微信访问后启动独立桥接服务，将文件传输助手中的文字带回聊天流；消息中的 @主题 可作为标签。
dsh-super-chat 的使用须知：可选微信桥接需要已保存的微信登录凭据，并连接微信文件传输助手服务；相关地址见 wechat/src/wxweb.mjs:9-10。

dsh-super-chat README · dsh-super-chat：A Super Chat panel for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one general chat stream where messages can carry several topic tags. With `dsh-superagent-prototype` installed, topics act as task-dispatch cues and untagged messages are left for Superagent to decide.

dsh-super-chat README · What this repository is：- **A Super Chat plugin for dsh-superagent-prototype**: its core is a `super-chat` Source that turns chat messages into Tickets; it also provides one tagged chat stream, SQLite storage and topic-filtered views.
- **Superagent Tickets**: the plugin connects through the prototype's public `orchestrator` service; acknowledgements and results return to the same stream. Prototype code is not modified; a single general DSH Session is the fallback when the prototype is absent.
- **`wechat/`**: an optional WeChat File Transfer Helper bridge. It defaults to the general chat and uses `@topic` to tag messages.

dsh-super-chat README · Repository layout：| Path | What it is | Checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| root (`src/`, `tests/`, `docs/`) | the standalone plugin (`dsh-super-chat` package) | `pnpm check` at the root |
| `wechat/` | the WeChat bridge (separate Node.js process) | `cd wechat && npm test` |

dsh-super-chat README · Repository layout：The root plugin and the separately installed `dsh-superagent-prototype` are independent. The plugin reaches the prototype only through its public `orchestrator` service; when that service is absent or unconfigured, one general DSH Session takes over.

dsh-super-chat README · Features：- **All messages**: every message goes into one stream; this is the panel's main view and replaces the former "General chat" label. The panel opens at the newest page and loads older messages when you scroll up.
- **<No topic> view**: shows only messages that carry no tags, with a live count in the sidebar; it is a read-time filter and changes neither storage, dispatch nor the topic list.
- **Topic views**: topics are tags on messages, not separate conversations. One message may carry several tags and appears in every matching view.
- **Topics are dispatch cues**: for a tagged message the first tag becomes the `super-chat` dispatch thread; untagged messages go to `general` and Superagent decides. Tags never force the outcome.
- **Auto-tagging**: the general chat's header labels untagged messages with existing topics through the profile's default model; only empty tags are filled, agent replies inherit them, and no topics are created.
- **Manual tag editing**: each message's tag row can add or remove tags and save; only that message changes, a new name creates a topic, and no work is dispatched.

dsh-super-chat README · Requirements：- DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or a compatible `0.2.x` Web profile (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`).
- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+.
- A model provider configured in the profile, as for any normal DSH Session.

dsh-super-chat README · Install：Published package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-super-chat
```

From a checkout (build first; a `link:` install does not build it):

```sh
git clone <this repository> dsh-super-chat
cd dsh-super-chat
pnpm install
pnpm build

A git-URL install runs the package's `prepare` build; pnpm may ask you to allow that script.

dsh-super-chat README · Install：`dsh plugin add` installs the package and appends it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the profile, then open **Super Chat** from the shortcut at the right of the **Superagent** sidebar row.

dsh-super-chat README · Configuration：Every option has a working default. Override it in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: super-chat
  config:
    # Directory for chat.sqlite; defaults to $DSH_HOME/state/super-chat.
    stateDir: /home/you/.dsh/state/super-chat

dsh-super-chat README · How it works：- A message id deduplicates retries; the same submission never opens a second Ticket.
- A topic view filters the one stream by tag. It does not copy messages or create separate storage.
- For tagged messages the Superagent Trigger text starts with a `[topics: …]` cue; the chat itself keeps the original text.
- Untagged messages use `super-chat:general`, leaving it to Superagent's assessment to accept, split or ignore them.
- Agent replies return through the Source Channel. The Channel address carries topic ids, so a reply appears in its topic view and in the general chat.

dsh-super-chat README · Superagent integration：When `dsh-superagent-prototype` is installed in the same profile, its runtime exposes the public `orchestrator` SourceHost service. The plugin registers a Source named `super-chat` and seeds its Policy with the fixed local sender, `local`.

dsh-super-chat README · Superagent integration：- **Tagged**: the first tag selects the `super-chat:topic:<topicId>` dispatch thread; every tag is carried in Trigger meta and the text cue. Tags are hints, not hard constraints.
- **Untagged**: uses `super-chat:general`; the general chat is left entirely to Superagent.
- **Chat-only**: the prototype's setup normally requires a GitHub repository and signed-in `gh` CLI. When both GitHub fields are empty the plugin wraps the prototype's `Setup` class in memory, accepts an empty deployment and asks the prototype to restart. No prototype file is modified. Workers in that mode have no GitHub tooling. This compatibility path covers the chat Source only; if Feishu is also needed, configure GitHub as the prototype expects so its original setup can handle Feishu.
- **Workspace grouping**: the prototype creates a Workspace for every ticket directory. The plugin keeps one **Superagent** Workspace over the prototype's state directory and folds ticket Workspaces into that group in the browser; the orchestrator Session is pinned first. `docs/architecture.md` records the mechanics and limits.

dsh-super-chat README · Permissions and approvals：- The fallback Session inherits the profile's permission preset unless `permissionPreset` is set. The panel has no approval UI, so an asking preset can leave a turn waiting.
- Superagent Tickets use the prototype's own executor permissions, concurrency and directory settings; this plugin only provides the chat entry point and topic dispatch.

dsh-super-chat README · WeChat remote access (started on demand)：`wechat/` is a separate Node.js bridge for WeChat's File Transfer Helper. **Opening the panel's WeChat access starts the bridge on demand**, so it does not need to be launched first; while saved credentials (`stateDir/wechat/creds.json`) exist, the host also automatically resumes and keeps the bridge alive across restarts and background checks; an already-running external bridge is reused. It defaults to the general chat: ordinary text goes there, and `@topic` tokens are extracted from the body as tags, for example:

dsh-super-chat README · WeChat remote access (started on demand)：```
帮我看下 @设计 这个页面
```

sends `帮我看下 这个页面` tagged `设计`. Several `@topic` tokens become several tags. There are no `/list`, `/use` or `/new` commands; everything is natural language. Tagged agent replies appear in WeChat as `「设计」reply`.

Run it manually only for troubleshooting or when the bridge should stay resident independently of DSH; point it at the panel port:

```sh
cd wechat
SUPERCHAT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3082 ./run-superchat.sh
```

dsh-super-chat README · WeChat remote access (started on demand)：The bridge listens on `127.0.0.1:8790`; the on-demand manager stores login and cursors under `stateDir/wechat/` (an old manual `wechat/creds.json` is copied once). Credentials and chat data are ignored by git. Use a secondary WeChat account: personal-account automation carries a ban risk. See [wechat/README.md](wechat/README.md) for configuration, tests and limits.

dsh-super-chat README · Privacy and security：- Chats are stored in `chat.sqlite` under `stateDir` and never uploaded by this plugin. Messages reach the configured model provider like any DSH Session; do not paste secrets into a chat.
- The HTTP API is same-origin with the DSH Web UI and requires `x-super-chat-request: 1`, a matching `Host` and no foreign `Origin`. This is CSRF protection, not authentication; the DSH Web Server still authenticates the human. Keep it on loopback unless you understand the exposure.
- Superagent Tickets use the prototype's execution environment and permissions; this plugin only writes SQLite, registers one HTTP route and reads Session events.
- No analytics, telemetry, remote fonts or external assets.

dsh-super-chat README · Limitations：- Text only; the panel does not accept images or file attachments yet.
- Replies arrive by polling (2.5 s), not token streaming.
- The panel reads the newest 50 messages first and fetches older pages as you scroll up, up to the retained stream limit.
- Topics are labels and dispatch cues, not strict partitions; the first tag chooses the dispatch thread and Superagent may still decide otherwise.
- The fallback has a single Session, so every message shares one model context; tagged replies inherit their turn's tags and appear in both All messages and their matching topic views.
- The plugin does not ship a ticket pipeline or worker pool; those come from `dsh-superagent-prototype`.
- Multi-user behavior is limited to what the DSH Web Server already provides.
- The panel uses absolute `/super-chat/api` paths and checks the configured bind host; path-prefix or different-authority reverse proxies are not supported.
